feature: Ctrl-click document/file/web navigation, confirmed selection wrapping, staged code Ctrl+A
build: Final all-target Debug build succeeded after modifier-key and IME event handling fixes.

regression.scope: Nine complete related groups on the final build; all 17 registered groups were not rerun for this change.

rules.links: Ctrl+left-click in either view resolves current-document relative paths, library-root paths, encoded Unicode/spaces and Windows absolute paths. Library-contained MD opens through MainWindow; other local targets and web URLs use QDesktopServices.
rules.wrapping: Mouse or keyboard selection remains unchanged while delimiter input accumulates. Enter commits one source transaction without newline. Esc cancels; Backspace corrects pending markers. Original content remains selected, including backwards selections.
rules.selectAll: Inside a closed fenced body, successive Ctrl+A presses select the logical line, code body, then entire source. Single-line and empty bodies retain separate stages. Modifier keys and empty IME refresh events do not reset the sequence.

focusedCoverage: 60 QtTest records cover both views, forward/backward selections, actual mouse drags, multiple delimiters, cancellation/correction, Chinese IME commits, empty IME refresh, staged selections, shared undo, and link dispatch with unsaved edits retained.

visualVerification.result: Inspected selected body, pending raw delimiters and Enter/Esc instructions; source text is unchanged before confirmation.

externalApplicationTest: Default-app/browser dispatch was intercepted with QDesktopServices URL handlers. Automated checks did not launch real external programs or browsers.
desktopLauncher: Existing Tmd Debug.lnk and scripts/Start-Debug.ps1 -CheckOnly verified against the rebuilt Debug executable.
dataIsolation: Temporary libraries and isolated settings only; actual md_data/md_photo and pre-existing workspace changes retained. No release, GitHub sync or normal Debug launch.
